subject: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Bcc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadiahealth.org>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@arcadiahealth.org>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>, Noah Chen <noah.chen@quantapay.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)
Attachments: Reference_Call_Prep_One_Pager_(Internal).pdf; Redwood_Reference_Call_Ground_Rules_v1.docx

Hi all —

Looping in our internal routing CCs and (via Bcc) the customer stakeholders who have agreed in principle to participate in reference calls.

Goal of this note is to align on the “ground rules” and scheduling expectations so we can keep the process lightweight for you and predictable for our team.

Proposed reference call boundaries (please reply with any edits):
1) Frequency: max 1 call / month unless explicitly approved otherwise.
2) Duration: 30 minutes (option to extend to 45 if everyone is available).
3) Notice: 5 business days lead time; questions/agenda shared at least 48 hours in advance.
4) Topics that are in-bounds:
   - High-level workload + why you chose Redwood (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
   - High-level architecture patterns (no proprietary diagrams required)
   - Operational outcomes (latency, reliability, cost directionally) as previously approved
   - Deployment/security requirements at a high level (e.g., VPC, audit logging expectations)
5) Topics that are out-of-bounds:
   - Pricing/discounts/contract terms
   - Unreleased roadmap details
   - Customer-specific sensitive data, regulated data, or vendor comparisons not already public
6) Redwood attendance: optional (CSM always on the invite; SE may join if the prospect is highly technical).
7) NDA: if the prospect is not already under NDA with you, Redwood will require a mutual NDA between prospect and customer (or we can keep the call at a high level).

Scheduling windows (what we have as defaults — please confirm):
- Arcadia Health: Tue/Thu 10:00am–12:00pm ET (two 30-min slots/month)
- QuantaPay: Wed 2:00pm–4:00pm ET (two 30-min slots/month)

If this looks right, please reply with:
- Confirmed spokesperson name(s) + title(s)
- Any specific “avoid” topics we should add
- Any blackout dates for the next 6–8 weeks

Thanks again — we’ll keep the process tight and will only request calls for qualified late-stage prospects.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference


---

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadiahealth.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@arcadiahealth.org>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 12:41 PM ET
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Hi Rachel —

This is good. A few edits on our side:

- Frequency: we’d like to cap at 1 call per *quarter* through the end of 2025. We can revisit if it’s not too disruptive.
- Topics to avoid (additions): anything that could imply patient data flows, retention periods, or internal system names. We’re fine saying “regulated healthcare workload in a private network” but want to keep it generic.
- Scheduling: Tue/Thu 10–12 ET works. Please send questions in advance; we’ll respond in writing if we need to adjust wording.

Spokespeople:
- Maya Patel, Director of Platform Engineering
Backup/optional:
- Tom Reed, Security & Compliance (only if the prospect has deep security questions)

Blackout dates: week of July 1 (QBR + holiday).

Thanks,
Maya


---

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Noah Chen <noah.chen@quantapay.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 10:08 PM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Rachel —

Works for us with a couple adjustments:

- Frequency: ok with up to 1 per month during July–Sept (assuming calls are truly late-stage). If we see too many, we’ll pause.
- Notice: 72 hours minimum is fine; 5 business days is better but not always realistic. Please do your best to give us a week.
- Avoid topics: anything about pricing/discounting is a hard no. Also please avoid “we moved off vendor X” type comparisons.

Scheduling window: Wed 2–4 ET works. Noah and I can split depending on the technical depth.

Spokespeople:
- Elena Rossi, VP Engineering
- Noah Chen, Head of Platform

Blackouts: Aug 19–23 (team offsite).

Thank you,
Elena


---

From: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 7:32 PM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Thanks Rachel.

Action items I’m hearing:
- Arcadia: update to 1/quarter cap + security-specific “avoid” list
- QuantaPay: keep 1/mo but try for 1 week notice; hard no on pricing and competitor mentions

Do we want to require a pre-call 10 min prep with the customer every time (even if Redwood attends)?

Miguel


---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 7:58 PM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Yes — let’s standardize a quick prep.

Proposal:
- 10-min prep (CSM + AE + customer spokesperson) required for every reference call
- If SE attends, they join prep if there are technical questions to steer
- We send “approved topics” + “avoid topics” in the invite description

I’ll log the constraints in HubSpot tonight (reference readiness + cadence) and update the internal reference roster.

Rachel

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 8:07 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Works.

For QuantaPay specifically: can we set an internal SLA that we don’t request a call unless we’ve completed (1) security review checkpoint and (2) benchmark results shared? Keeps it to late-stage like Elena said.

Priyom

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 10:22 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

+1 to the gating. Happy to be the default SE for QuantaPay references.

For Arcadia, given the “no retention periods / no patient data flows” constraint, I’d suggest we keep SE off the call unless the prospect is already in a security deep dive. If we do join, we should stick to Redwood’s general VPC + audit log capabilities and avoid Arcadia-specific implementation details.

Markus

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 11:36 AM PT
Subject: Re: Reference call program: boundaries + scheduling windows (Arcadia / QuantaPay)

Agreed.

I’m adding internal gating rules:
- QuantaPay references only after (a) benchmark summary shared and (b) security/procurement stage confirmed by AE/CS.
- Arcadia references capped at 1/quarter; SE attendance by exception only.

Next steps on my side:
- Update HubSpot reference fields for Arcadia (118392) + QuantaPay (118407)
- Add blackout dates + preferred windows to the reference roster
- Create calendar placeholders so scheduling doesn’t drift

Thanks all.

Rachel
